role: development-only local waveform surrogate diagnostic on already spent depth records
origin_time_handling: shift every neighbour waveform from its training origin time to the target origin time before spatial interpolation
limits: Hyperparameters are selected on eight already inspected depth records. This is a lower-complexity FD-record interpolation baseline, not a PINN, not independent validation, and not yet a continuous inversion operator. Convex local interpolation cannot be expected to extrapolate reliably outside source coverage.
